title: CNIL fines EXTIA 300,000 euros for failing to respect individuals' rights
content_md:
CNIL fines EXTIA 300,000 euros for failing to respect individuals' rights. What stands out: these are not the fines themselves but the underlying violations. Read more at https://www.cnil.fr/fr/sanction-non-respect-droits-personnes-extia
